# State-feature selection on recorded git calls

*Generated by `research/state_eval.py` from `real-mcp/results_history_predicate/controller/git/`.*

A deterministic depth-2 decision tree selects among the index-state counters read before each call (zeroed stat data, smudged sizes, racily clean entries, entry count) and the tool names.  It is fitted on controller seeds 7–8 and scored on seeds 9–10 (seed 10 is the paired-probe sequence).  The per-tool baseline sees the same receipts and reviews every tool that rewrote the index in training.  Every call is legitimate, so every review is a held legitimate call.

Training: 44 read-only calls, 2 index rewrites. Evaluation: 41 read-only calls, 10 rewrites.

| Comparator | Reviewed legitimate calls | Reviews on rewrites | Reviews without rewrite | Rewrites allowed |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Allow all | 0/41 | 0/10 | 0 | 10 |
| Review all | 41/41 | 10/10 | 31 | 0 |
| Per-tool observed deviation (dynamic baseline) | 22/41 | 8/10 | 14 | 2 |
| Automatic tree (existing state fields) | 14/41 | 10/10 | 4 | 0 |
| Hand-written state predicate S | 10/41 | 10/10 | 0 | 0 |

Selected tree (training data only):

```json
{
  "feature": "index.smudged>0",
  "no": {
    "leaf": "allow",
    "positive": 0,
    "samples": 41
  },
  "yes": {
    "feature": "tool:git_log",
    "no": {
      "leaf": "review",
      "positive": 2,
      "samples": 2
    },
    "yes": {
      "leaf": "allow",
      "positive": 0,
      "samples": 1
    }
  }
}
```

The tree selects `index.smudged>0`, the condition S is written on, from two positive training calls, and adds reviews only for read-only tools that do not stat the working tree.  Frozen and evaluated on ten new seeds of scripted traffic, it flags every rewrite (`real-mcp/analysis/GUARDED_RUN.md` §1).
